content.label: Shared node request
content.description: Queues this ticket's work for a shared node of the project (a build, a test run, a deploy) and waits for this ticket's share of the batch result. 'done': the batch succeeded. 'error': the batch failed and this ticket is to blame (or the request could not be served); its data has 'errorsForThisTicket'.

params.name: sharedNode
params.label: Shared node
params.description: Name of the project's shared node to queue for.
